newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA ROMP TO RECORD WON OVER TONGA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA ROMP TO RECORD WON OVER TONGA.

text.p: South Africa romped to a record 74-10 victory with 12 tries against a hopelessly outclassed Tonga at Newlands on Tuesday.
It eclipsed their previous highest score of 60-8 against Western Samoa in 1995.

Left wing Andre Snyman had three tries and flanker Ruben Kruger, hooker Naka Drotske and winger James Small two each as the Springboks enjoyed an easy warm-up for the first test against the British Lions at the same ground on June 21.
Lock Fritz van Heerden, hooker Naka Drotske and scrum-half Joost van der Westhuizen also got on the scoresheet as the Springboks kept the ball alive at every opportunity.
Debutant centre Edrich Lubbe was successful with seven out of 12 conversions.
Tonga conceded five tries in the opening 18 minutes to fall 33-3 behind but bravely denied the Sprinboks a further score in the half.
However a try within a minute of the restart from Snyman, who then quickly completed his hat-trick, set the tone for the romp to continue.
Tonga's consolation came from prop Ngaslu Ta'u from a quickly taken five-metre penalty.
The only bad news for South Africa was that Small, Van Heerden and skipper Gary Teichmann all limped off with injuries.

South Africa - 15-Andre Joubert, 14-James Small (Russell Bennett, 65), 13-Japie Mulder, 12-Edrich Lubbe, 11-Andre Snyman, 10-Henry Honiball, 9-Joost van der Westhuizen, 8-Gary Teichmann (captain) (Mark Andrews, 24), 7-Andre Venter, 6-Ruben Kruger, 5-Fitz van Heerden (James Dalton, 61), 4-Hannes Strydom, 3-Adrian Garvey, 2-Naka Drotske, 1-Os du Randt.

Tonga - 15-Gustavo Tonga (Chris Schumkel, 66), 14-Semisi Faka'osifolau, 13-Fepokou Tatafu, 12-Viliami Uhi, 11-Simana Mifileo, 10-Siau Taumalolo, 9-Manu Vunipola (Semi Tulikifanga, 67), 8-Katelimi Tuipolotu, 7-Ma'ama Molitika, 6-Loni Katoa, 5-Kuli Faleau (Tilanoa Johi, 72), 4-'Alipate Taufo'ou, 3-Heamani Lavaka, 2-Fe'ao Vunipola, 1-Ngaslu Ta'u.
